dataset.description: A quantitative survey of employers is expected to shed new light on how Latvian employers interpret, relate to and put in practice rules, anti-discrimination policies and possibly in their hiring practices and in the workplace outline proactive duties in policy documents and official guidelines.

distribution.title: The sample for the study will include companies from different fields (e.g., manufacturing, finance, health, IT, construction and agriculture) in order to represent heterogeneous job characteristics with respect to skill level, gender share, innovation dependency and turnover rates.

dataset.description: Survey on how municipalities involve different groups of society, including immigrants, in solving development issues important to the municipalities or cities.

distribution.title: The purpose of the survey is to improve understanding of the potential of population advisory groups in Latvian local governments in order to promote local communities cohesion and development. We want to know how active different population groups are in the municipality, taking part in solving topical issues. How engaged in this process are those local government residents who have come to Latvia from other countries as refugees, including from Ukraine, or by marrying, because of work, and simply moving to live. For the sake of clarity, we call this population group in the survey: immigrants or arrivals from other countries.

dataset.title: Survey of municipalities in Latvia

dataset.description: This study concentrates on five municipalities in Latvia. Its goal is to achieve a comprehensive understanding of the ways these municipalities engage with refugees, encompassing Ukrainian civilians and other newcomers from abroad residing within their boundaries. The case studies aim to explore the local integration management strategies employed in response to uncertainty, with a specific focus on the resources and tactics utilized by municipalities to collaborate with other stakeholders in facilitating migrant reception, municipal development, and fostering community cohesion.

distribution.title: Through case studies of municipalities, the project will map actors that play an important role in municipal development and cohesion efforts involving refugees and migrants.

dataset.title: Case studies of municipalities in Latvia

dmp.description: Migration and integration researchers usually see integration is a reciprocal process of adaptation between migrants and host societies, holding both migrants and hosts equally responsible for integration outcomes. In practice, however, the focus has largely been on the responsibilities of migrants, without appreciating the context of the host country, the attitudes of the population and the role of the various integration agents. How integration is understood, interpreted and implemented in everyday practice by what Lipsky (2010) refers to as ‘street level bureaucrats’, and how society and different local actors adapt to and welcome migrants into their communities, is important for the social inclusion of migrants to be truly successful. Coordination between the different actors involved in providing support to refugees is also very important, and has not always been successful in the Latvian case.
